text.content: THEN YOU REALIZE IT'S A WEEKEND

description: The meme features two panels. The top panel shows a happy character with the text 'WHEN WE'RE PUMPING...', and a graph going up. The bottom panel shows the same character looking disappointed with the text 'THEN YOU REALIZE IT'S A WEEKEND', implying the excitement was for nothing. The character's expression and graph background highlight the contrasting emotions.
